# arcane_command (Action)

Runs an Arcane command and shows the response as a progress message. A command is an action that a resource kind defines, run with `POST <collection>/<command>`.

The result is not kept anywhere. Use the `arcane_command` resource to keep it in state. The token needs the RBAC `commands` permission `<plural>/<command>`.

Actions need Terraform 1.14 or later.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Actions need Terraform 1.14 or later.
# Run with: terraform apply -invoke=action.arcane_command.rebuild_index
# The response is shown as a progress message and is not kept in state.
action "arcane_command" "rebuild_index" {
  config {
    api_version = "sample.arcane.pubg.io/v1"
    kind        = "Pet"
    namespace   = "default"
    command     = "rebuild-index"

    # body is shown in plan unless you pass it as a sensitive value
    body = <<-YAML
spec:
  scope: all
YAML

    sensitive_fields = ["status.token"]
  }
}

# Run it after another resource is created or updated
resource "terraform_data" "index" {
  input = "v1"

  lifecycle {
    action_trigger {
      events  = [after_create, after_update]
      actions = [action.arcane_command.rebuild_index]
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `api_version` (String) apiVersion of the resource kind the command belongs to, not of the command object, such as `sample.arcane.pubg.io/v1`.
- `command` (String) Name of the command, as API discovery lists it for the kind.
- `kind` (String) Kind of the resource the command belongs to, not of the command object.

### Optional

- `body` (String) YAML of the command object. Pass secrets with sensitive values; this attribute is shown in plan otherwise. When it is empty or has no `kind`, the provider sends the command kind that API discovery lists. It does not fill `apiVersion`. Arcane API servers that do not yet accept a command body without `apiVersion` reject it with 422, so write `apiVersion` in the body for them. When the command fails, string values from `body` that the server repeats in its error are shown as `******`.
- `namespace` (String) Namespace of the resource kind. Required for a namespaced kind, and not allowed for a cluster-scoped one.
- `sensitive_fields` (List of String) Field paths of the response to read as `******` in the progress message, using the same syntax as `ignore_fields` of `arcane_api_resource`, such as `status.token`. A path also covers every field under it.
